structuralBytesPerCommitWorst.unit: bytes per commit, message text excluded, at 24577 commits: the worst size on the growth curve, 24.2 per cent column slack with the hash index newly doubled

structuralBytesPerCommit.unit: bytes per commit, message text excluded, at 20000 commits: mid-cycle, 22.1 per cent column slack

structuralBytesPerCommitLarge.unit: bytes per commit, message text excluded, at 80000 commits: mid-cycle, 16.4 per cent column slack

scalingRatio.unit: times the work of 20000 commits, for 80000 of them: 22.1 and 16.4 per cent slack, neither size capacity-exact

workPerCommit.unit: counted operations per commit, over 80000 commits: 16.4 per cent column slack

buildMilliseconds.unit: milliseconds to append 10000 commits, the slowest of the 24577, 20000 and 80000 builds normalised to ten thousand
